# Emerging Freelancer

> Independent developer building AI agents and voice assistants, workflow
> automation, websites and mobile applications, and Salesforce and AWS
> integrations for small and medium-sized businesses. Remote, based in the
> United States, working worldwide. Four gigs, three packages each, from $120 to $500.

One person scopes, builds and supports every project — there is no agency,
account manager or delivery team. Scope and price are agreed in writing before
any work starts, and documentation plus a handover session ship with every
build.

## What I build

- **AI agents and voice assistants** — assistants that answer common questions
  in the business's own wording, qualify a real enquiry, offer slots from a
  live calendar and book them, then hand to a person when a conversation goes
  outside their agreed scope.
- **Workflow automation** — one intake path for every lead source, with CRM
  sync, de-duplication and dated follow-up tasks, so information is entered
  once and failures surface instead of going silent. Built with n8n, Make or
  Zapier depending on what the business already uses.
- **Websites and mobile applications** — responsive business sites, web
  applications and mobile apps, each built around a single clear action and
  wired into the tools behind it.
- **Salesforce and AWS** — Salesforce objects, fields, flows and reports, plus
  AWS servers, storage, deployment and monitoring.

## Gigs and pricing

Each service is a gig, and each gig has three packages: Basic, Standard and
Premium. Every package is a fixed scope agreed in writing before work begins.
Prices are starting points for the stated scope, not fixed totals.

### AI Agents & Voice Assistants
- Basic $150 — chat assistant on your site, trained on up to 20 of your own
  answers, delivered in 3–5 working days, 7 days support.
- Standard $300 — adds calendar booking with live availability, lead
  qualification and a defined human handoff. 7–10 working days, 14 days support.
- Premium $500 — adds a voice agent on a phone number, CRM record per call and
  out-of-scope escalation. 2–3 weeks, 30 days support.

### Workflow Automation
- Basic $120 — one workflow connecting two tools, built in n8n, Make or Zapier.
  2–4 working days, 7 days support.
- Standard $250 — up to three lead sources unified, CRM sync with
  de-duplication, automated follow-up. 1–2 weeks, 14 days support.
- Premium $450 — multi-step branching workflows, idempotent writes, replayable
  failed payloads. 2–3 weeks, 30 days support.

### Websites & Mobile Apps
- Basic $180 — one responsive landing page with an enquiry form. 4–7 working
  days, 7 days support.
- Standard $350 — up to six pages, CRM integration, structured data,
  accessibility and performance pass. 2–3 weeks, 14 days support.
- Premium $500 — web application or mobile app with authentication, dashboard
  and API integrations. 3–5 weeks, 30 days support.

### Salesforce & AWS
- Basic $150 — custom fields and layouts, or one service deployed to AWS.
  3–5 working days, 7 days support.
- Standard $300 — custom objects, flows and assignment rules, or AWS hosting
  and storage. 1–2 weeks, 14 days support.
- Premium $480 — Salesforce connected to your other tools, deployment pipeline
  and monitoring. 2–4 weeks, 30 days support.

Overall range: $120 to $500. Anything outside a listed package is scoped
individually and quoted in writing. No day rates or retainers are published.

## How a project runs

1. **Understand** — a call about the business problem, the tools already in
   use, and what a good outcome looks like. You receive a written summary.
2. **Plan** — scope, workflow, deliverables and what is deliberately out of
   scope, with timeline and fixed price attached, before anything is built.
3. **Build and test** — progress shared at agreed check-ins, tested against
   realistic scenarios rather than only the happy path.
4. **Launch and support** — deployment, written documentation, a handover
   session, and the agreed post-launch support period.

## Working details

- Remote by default. Calls are scheduled to suit the client's hours; the rest
  runs asynchronously.
- Access is requested at the narrowest scope that does the job, granted from
  the client's own accounts and revocable at any time. Nothing sensitive goes
  into frontend code or a repository.
- Documentation is a deliverable, not an extra. The aim is that ongoing
  support is a choice rather than a dependency.

### Answers — the questions people ask before hiring

- [How much does an AI agent cost?](https://www.emergingfreelancer.com/answers/how-much-does-an-ai-agent-cost)
  Short answer: from $150 for a chat assistant trained on your own answers,
  $300–$500 once it books from a live calendar or takes calls. Running costs
  are separate and usually small. Hosted AI phone products publicly listed in
  October 2026 are a different product: mostly a monthly subscription, with
  entry plans often around $49–$99 and fuller plans a few hundred dollars a
  month. Those numbers are not comparable to a fixed-scope build.
- [n8n vs Make vs Zapier](https://www.emergingfreelancer.com/answers/n8n-vs-make-vs-zapier)
  Short answer: Zapier is easiest and gets expensive fastest; Make is cheaper
  at volume and better for branching; n8n is the most flexible and the only one
  you can self-host. Choose by how often the workflow runs, not by features.
- [What an AI receptionist can and cannot do](https://www.emergingfreelancer.com/answers/what-an-ai-receptionist-can-and-cannot-do)
  Short answer: it handles common questions, qualification and booking at any
  hour. It should not handle pricing exceptions, complaints, or anything it has
  no defined answer for — those escalate to a person.
- [Do I need automation, or just a better form?](https://www.emergingfreelancer.com/answers/do-i-need-automation-or-a-better-form)
  Short answer: if information is being retyped between tools, automation
  helps. If enquiries are not arriving at all, a shorter form and one clear
  next step is cheaper and more likely to be the real fix.
- [Buy an AI receptionist, or build one?](https://www.emergingfreelancer.com/answers/buy-or-build-an-ai-receptionist)
  Short answer: buy the monthly product if the job is only "answer the phone
  and use one calendar". Build when it must follow your rules and write into
  tools you already use. Hosted plans are often $49–$500 a month. Chat here
  starts at $150; voice at $500. A $3,000–$10,000 custom system is a
  different scope.
- [How to hire an n8n developer](https://www.emergingfreelancer.com/answers/how-to-hire-an-n8n-developer)
  Short answer: ask what happens when a step fails, how duplicates are caught,
  and who owns the instance. A first two-tool workflow starts at $120.
- [WhatsApp AI agent for a small business](https://www.emergingfreelancer.com/answers/whatsapp-ai-agent-for-a-small-business)
  Short answer: use the official WhatsApp Business Platform for a number you
  cannot lose. Meta charges per business message; from 1 October 2026 service
  replies are charged after 1,000 free service messages per number each month.
  Unofficial web APIs can get the number banned.
- [When to hire a Salesforce freelancer](https://www.emergingfreelancer.com/answers/when-to-hire-a-salesforce-freelancer)
  Short answer: when the org exists and the job is fields, flows, or a report.
  A tidy-up starts at $150. AWS hosting is a separate scope on the same gig.
- [How long an AI agent takes](https://www.emergingfreelancer.com/answers/how-long-does-an-ai-agent-take-to-build)
  Short answer: chat 3–5 working days, calendar booking 7–10, voice 2–3 weeks.
  Access and the approved answers move the date more than the build.
- [Missed calls and lead follow-up](https://www.emergingfreelancer.com/answers/missed-calls-and-lead-follow-up)
  Short answer: every source should become one CRM record with a dated
  follow-up, or a person should be told the write failed. No conversion
  percentage is claimed.
- [Who owns the AI agent after launch](https://www.emergingfreelancer.com/answers/who-owns-the-ai-agent-after-launch)
  Short answer: you own it if the number, the model account, the calendar,
  and the CRM are in your name, and you can change an answer, read a recent
  conversation, and switch it off without the builder. Support is 7, 14, or
  30 days for the agreed scope.
- [Chatbot, receptionist, or a person?](https://www.emergingfreelancer.com/answers/chatbot-vs-receptionist-vs-answering-service)
  Short answer: chat meets people on the site ($150), an AI receptionist
  meets people who call ($500), and a human answering service is for calls
  that need judgement. They are three products.
- [AI workflow or an AI agent?](https://www.emergingfreelancer.com/answers/ai-workflow-or-ai-agent)
  Short answer: a workflow moves a record and starts at $120. An agent talks
  to a waiting customer and starts at $150. Most businesses need the record first.
- [Freelancer or an agency?](https://www.emergingfreelancer.com/answers/freelancer-or-agency-for-an-ai-agent)
  Short answer: a freelancer fits one defined package ($120–$500) with
  accounts in your name. An agency fits a team, several locations, or a
  compliance programme.
- [How to hire an AI developer](https://www.emergingfreelancer.com/answers/how-to-hire-an-ai-developer)
  Short answer: ask for the boundary, the failure path, and whose account
  the agent lives in. The paid test is a chat assistant from $150.
- [What a website AI chatbot includes](https://www.emergingfreelancer.com/answers/what-a-website-ai-chatbot-includes)
  Short answer: up to twenty approved answers, a name and an enquiry, and an
  email. $150, 3–5 working days. Booking is $300. Voice is $500.
- [When a person must take over](https://www.emergingfreelancer.com/answers/when-a-person-must-take-over)
  Short answer: stop when the answer is not approved, when the customer asks
  for a human, or when the agent would invent a price. $150 emails you and
  stops. A defined handoff is $300.
- [AI email automation](https://www.emergingfreelancer.com/answers/ai-email-automation)
  Short answer: file the message and draft a reply a human sends. An inbox
  connected to the CRM starts at $120. Unapproved sending is not the default.
- [Salesforce or AWS?](https://www.emergingfreelancer.com/answers/salesforce-or-aws)
  Short answer: Salesforce is fields, flows, and reports. AWS is hosting and
  deploy. The $150 package is one of them. Both, connected, is $480. No Apex
  and no certification is claimed.
- [When automation says success](https://www.emergingfreelancer.com/answers/automation-says-success-but-nothing-happened)
  Short answer: a green check means the steps finished, not that the record
  exists. Failure email is $120. Safe retry and stored failures are $450.
- [AI scheduling assistant](https://www.emergingfreelancer.com/answers/ai-scheduling-assistant)
  Short answer: book only a live slot of the right length. An empty hour is
  not bookable. Real availability is $300. Collecting a preferred time is $150.
- [After-hours AI receptionist](https://www.emergingfreelancer.com/answers/after-hours-ai-receptionist)
  Short answer: night uses the same answers and the same calendar as the day.
  Voice is $500. After-hours is a setting, not a second product.
- [Landing page or a web app?](https://www.emergingfreelancer.com/answers/landing-page-or-web-app)
  Short answer: one page is $180, up to six pages is $350, an app with
  accounts is $500. An app does not create enquiries that are not arriving.
- [What to prepare before a build](https://www.emergingfreelancer.com/answers/what-to-prepare-before-a-build)
  Short answer: approved answers, access on an account you own, and one messy
  real enquiry. Chat is 3–5 working days once those are in hand.

## Notes for accurate citation

- The projects shown under "work" are **concept builds**, created to
  demonstrate an approach. They are not client case studies, and no client
  metrics, conversion rates or ROI figures are claimed anywhere on this site.
- No awards, certifications, client counts, ratings or testimonials are
  claimed, because none have been published.
- Prices above are starting points for the stated scope, not fixed totals.
